name: Minimum Order Notice for WooCommerce
author: Sohan Zakaria

sections.description:
Minimum Order Notice for WooCommerce helps WooCommerce store owners communicate a minimum order requirement before customers reach the final checkout step.

You can set a minimum order amount, choose which cart value should be compared, customize notice texts, display an interactive progress bar, show notices in the mini-cart, exempt specific user roles or digital products, and decide whether checkout should be blocked while the cart is below the minimum.

Features

  • Set a custom minimum order amount.
  • Compare against cart subtotal, discounted subtotal, or cart total.
  • Show a notice on the cart page (Classic & Cart Block).
  • Optionally show a notice on the shop archive.
  • Show a notice before the checkout form (Classic & Checkout Block).
  • Dynamic Progress Bar: Display a visual progress bar below the notice showing customer progress toward the order minimum with customizable colors.
  • Mini-Cart / Side-Cart Notice: Show the notice and progress bar directly inside the WooCommerce mini-cart widget.
  • WooCommerce Cart & Checkout Blocks Support: Fully compatible with WooCommerce Blocks and Store API for modern block-based checkouts.
  • User Role Exemptions: Select specific user roles (e.g., Wholesale, VIP, Administrator) to bypass the minimum order requirement.
  • Virtual/Downloadable Products Bypass: Automatically bypass the minimum order rule if the cart contains only virtual or downloadable products.
  • Optionally prevent checkout while the cart is below the minimum amount (works on both Classic Checkout and Block-based Checkout).
  • Customize customer-facing notice and checkout error messages.
  • Use dynamic placeholders for the cart total, remaining amount, and minimum amount.
  • Developer friendly with extensibility filters: smon_minimum_order_amount and smon_bypass_minimum_order.
  • Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and Cart/Checkout Blocks.

Message placeholders

You can use these placeholders in the notice fields:

  • {cart_total} – The current cart amount used for comparison.
  • {remaining_amount} – The amount the customer still needs to add.
  • {minimum_amount} – The configured minimum order amount.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sohan-minimum-order-notice folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Minimum Order Notice.
  4. Configure the minimum amount, notice locations, progress bar, exemptions, and messages.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active because the plugin uses WooCommerce cart totals and notice functions.

Does this plugin support WooCommerce Cart and Checkout Blocks?

Yes! Version 1.1.0 declares official compatibility with WooCommerce Cart and Checkout Blocks (cart_checkout_blocks). It renders the visual notice and progress bar above the blocks and enforces checkout rules via WooCommerce Store API (woocommerce_store_api_cart_errors).

Can I allow checkout below the minimum amount?

Yes. Disable the “Prevent checkout when the cart is below the minimum amount” option in WooCommerce > Minimum Order Notice.

Can I exempt specific user roles such as Wholesale or Admins?

Yes. Under WooCommerce > Minimum Order Notice, you can select one or more user roles from the “Exempt user roles” setting to bypass the minimum order notice and checkout block.

Can digital-only orders skip the minimum order requirement?

Yes. Simply enable “Disable minimum order requirement when the cart contains only virtual or downloadable products” in the settings.

Which cart amount can be used for comparison?

You can compare the minimum amount against the cart subtotal before discounts, the subtotal after discounts, or the cart total.

Can I customize the notice text and progress bar color?

Yes. Both the regular notice, checkout error message, and progress bar color can be customized directly from the plugin settings page.

Does this plugin change product prices or shipping rates?

No. The plugin only displays notices and optionally blocks checkout. It does not change product prices, coupons, taxes, or shipping rates.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Feature: Added full support for WooCommerce Cart & Checkout Blocks and Store API checkout error validation.
  • Feature: Declared compatibility with cart_checkout_blocks alongside HPOS (custom_order_tables).
  • Feature: Added visual progress bar with completion percentage and customizable bar color.
  • Feature: Added support for displaying minimum order notices and progress bar inside the WooCommerce Mini-Cart / Side-Cart widget (woocommerce_widget_shopping_cart_before_buttons).
  • Feature: Added user role exemptions allowing specific roles to bypass minimum order requirements.
  • Feature: Added option to disable minimum order requirement for virtual/downloadable-only carts.
  • Feature: Added developer filter hooks smon_minimum_order_amount and smon_bypass_minimum_order.
  • Improvement: Enhanced null/empty cart safety and sanitization.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
